text:
Asha: Thanks everyone for sticking around for the reliability segment. Quick follow-up thread: RCA for this week's incident is published here: https://redwood.example/rca/INC-2026-042 — please read the summary and the action items. Recording clip starts at 00:17:30 for the reliability discussion. PTAL and add owners if anything's missing.

Daniel: Got it, thanks. Can we get a short clip of the part where we discussed fallback routing? Need to share with the product folks.

Asha: Yes — clip window is approx 00:18:10–00:21:00. @Marta can you extract and post the clip?

Marta: On it, ETA ~30m.

Priya: For action item #2 (canary rollout autopause) who will own the runbook update and the test plan?

Samir: I can take the runbook update. Will open a PR and tag @Priya for review.

Priya: Thanks @Samir. Please include a checklist: 1) test in staging, 2) 100k token load test, 3) validate fallback triggers and metrics.

Samir: Added checklist to ticket INC-2026-042#3 and started a draft PR.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: Incident INC-2026-042 state changed to "postmortem" by Asha.

Asha: One more thing — we need to notify Dedicated customers about the temporary routing change and reassure them about SLAs. @Daniel can you coordinate comms with Sales and Customer Success?

Daniel: Yep. I'll draft the note and post in #sales and #customer-success for review, then send to the dedicated customers list.

Marta: Clip posted: https://redwood.example/clips/1782102468-clip1.mp4

Priya: Also can the Optimize team get the regression prompt set used in the evals? That prevents surprise regressions when teams change models/quantization.

Samir: I'll include the prompt set and eval config in the PR (EOD tomorrow target).

Asha: Action items summary lives in the RCA doc — suggest we use that as the single source of truth. If you add owners, add them inline in the doc and ping here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
